basic_info.description: Starter Dream Home.Beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom located in the highly desirable Parkside neighborhood. This home features hardwood floors throughout and freshly painted interiors. Abundant skylights fill the space with natural light. On the market for the first time in 46 years, this gem boasts a spacious backyard with endless potential and a deep driveway for additional parking. Steps away from the public transportation and Noriega Street's vibrant coffee shops, restaurants and supermarkets.
